name: Synvector
description:
About This Game

ABOUT THE GAME

You lost most of your squadron protecting civilian convoy when the Unnamed came through. What's left is a handful of ships, unpaid repair bills, and a contract board.

Synvector is a 3D sci-fi Action RPG that combines fast-paced third-person space combat with real-time fleet command and tactical pause.

The entire known universe exists within a single spiral arm known as the Thorn Arm. Four civilizations fight for territory, resources, and survival while balancing on the edge of another war. Beyond the Frontier, the Unnamed continue to emerge from the darkness, and none of the races can stop them alone.

You lead a mercenary squadron operating on the frontier of civilized space. Pilot your flagship in third-person combat, coordinate multiple squadrons through the Synvector tactical interface, and switch between squadron commanders to control different fronts of the battlefield as the fight unfolds.

Take contracts, earn your reputation, recruit experienced captains, expand your command network, and build a fleet capable of changing the balance of power across the Thorn Arm.

Four races. One spiral arm. One threat none of them can face alone.

Nothing personal. Just contract.

TACTICAL FLEET COMBAT

  • Real-Time Fleet Battles with Tactical Pause

Fight across asteroid belts, nebulae, abandoned stations, planetary orbits, and dying star systems where the environment can be just as dangerous as the enemy. Slow down the battle at any moment to analyze the situation, reposition your squadrons, assign priority targets, coordinate attacks, and adapt your strategy before returning to full-speed combat.

  • Command From the Front

Take direct third-person control of your flagship while coordinating the rest of your fleet through the Synvector tactical interface. Switch between squadron commanders to control multiple engagements without leaving the battlefield.

  • Expand Your Command Network

Recruit experienced captains and expand your Synvector network to command larger formations. Every new squadron commander introduces new tactical options, allowing your fleet to fight as a single coordinated force.

  • Customize Your Fleet

Build specialized task forces using interceptors, bombers, artillery ships, missile platforms, support vessels, and heavy cruisers. Upgrade hulls, install advanced modules, improve shields, engines, and weapon systems, and create fleets that match your own combat doctrine.

RPG & LIVING GALAXY

  • Captains, Crew & Progression

Develop your flagship, improve your command abilities, and recruit experienced captains and officers, each bringing unique doctrines, combat bonuses, and tactical advantages. The right leadership can decide the outcome of an entire campaign.

  • Build Your Reputation

The Thorn Arm doesn't care who you were. Escort convoys, hunt pirates, protect trade routes, recover lost technology, explore dangerous frontier systems, or accept contracts no one else is willing to take. Your reputation determines who trusts you, who fears you, and who wants you dead.

  • Living Sandbox Galaxy

Trade routes shift. Borders change. Pirate factions rise. Political alliances collapse. Every civilization pursues its own ambitions while the Unnamed continue to threaten the Frontier. The galaxy evolves with or without your involvement.

  • Four Unique Civilizations

Discover four distinct races, each with its own culture, technologies, political struggles, combat doctrines, and ship designs. Earn their trust, exploit their rivalries, or unite them against a common enemy.

  • Explore the Thorn Arm

Travel freely across the entire known galaxy-from the industrial worlds of the Directorate to Shrazi clan territories, the isolated Krait theocracy, the frontier ruled by Diplin captains, and the dangerous Drift that separates them. Every region offers unique contracts, discoveries, characters, and stories.

KEY FEATURES

  • Fast-paced third-person space combat combined with real-time fleet command.

  • Tactical pause for issuing orders, coordinating squadrons, and adapting your strategy.

  • Switch between squadron commanders to control multiple fronts during battle.

  • Command and expand your own mercenary fleet through the Synvector network.

  • Recruit captains, customize ships, and build specialized combat formations.

  • Open sandbox galaxy shaped by war, piracy, trade, exploration, and political conflict.

  • Four unique civilizations with distinct technologies, cultures, fleets, and storylines.

  • Hundreds of contracts, side missions, discoveries, and opportunities across the Thorn Arm.

  • Story-driven sci-fi RPG with meaningful choices, faction reputation, and multiple paths through the galaxy.
short_desc: Real-time sci-fi action RPG with tactical pause. Command your mercenary fleet, coordinate squadrons through a command interface, and switch between squadron commanders. Four races, one spiral arm, one unstoppable swarm. Nothing personal. Just contract.
